info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Public Reference Data Management API
info.description: The Public Reference Data Management API facilitates the efficient management of banking market data, enabling users to create and manage reference data essential for various financial applications. This API allows businesses to streamline their data processes by integrating public reference data into their systems seamlessly. Typical consumers include financial institutions, fintech companies, and application developers who require reliable market data for analytics and reporting. With this API, users can ensure they have accurate and up-to-date reference data to support decision-making and strategy development.

post.description: This operation allows the user to create new public reference data in the market data system. By providing the necessary details in the request body, you can manage and store essential reference data for public use.
